title: A picture frame the kit writes through a setting slot (T4 page background) is listed in siteSettings, so the picture package exports with no problems
steps: S1: From the checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/site-pictures-setting-slot.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code and the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines.
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0': fillFrames lists the background frame tied to site.body-background in siteSettings (writeDoor none) and gives its two kit twins no entry; exportPictureMapping on that manifest has no problems and one siteSettings entry; packageProblems returns []; the ladder state lists the frame in siteSettings, and a frame whose slotId is not a slot of site.settingSlots stays in frames.

The write step no longer stops on one item (ADR 0044, decision 26): a look guard finding is written and kept in report.guard.findings, a slot the kit or the site does not have and a picture frame with no slot get a refused line naming the owning step, a file whose bytes are not its hash still stops the run, and the site check groups look-guard-findings and unaddressable-items block on each, naming the cell and the step.
evidence: Step 9 on a T4 kit with the writable background setting slot stopped BAD_FILE with 0 written: the picture mapping held 14 problems 'the kit has no image slot' for the background frame and its 13 twins.
fence: Mechanism only: which manifest list a setting slot frame lands in and that the export and the package check accept it. Not covered: the write step setting body_bg_img on a live site. Decision 26 part: covered with invented fixtures through runWriteStep and runSiteCheck; not covered on a live site.

tests: a frame of a setting slot goes to siteSettings
the fallback ladder lists a setting slot frame in siteSettings too
a writable frame with a slot id the kit does not list as a setting slot stays in frames
kitSlotIds reads ids nested under rowSlots[].slots[]
kitSlotIds keeps reading the flat rowSlots, rows and block slots
each look guard finding blocks, naming the cell and the step that owns the value
each item left out blocks on its owning step, with the cell
through a real run: a guard finding and a stray copy slot are written around, and the check names both cells and steps
a frame the export could not place is refused on its own line, naming the picture step, and the rest is written
a slot the site does not have is refused on its own, naming the picture step, and the others are written
a file whose bytes are not its hash stops the run
a copy slot the kit does not have is refused on its own line, naming the copy step, and the rest is written
